social_circle.name: Marisol Diaz

demographics.education: some college or associate-level administrative training

background.how_they_met: Marisol is Angel and Roberto's daughter.
background.why_close: Angel talks to Marisol almost every day, relies on her after Roberto, and includes her in family, health, political, school, and grandchild conversations.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts often, usually practical but warm; uses clear updates, links to reliable sources, and occasional family photos.

recent_text_topics: Coordinating Sunday meals, groceries, and what the grandchildren want to eat.
School schedules, late meetings, and whether Angel can help with pickup or babysitting.
Reliable health sources, vaccine or medical questions, and reminders about Angel's blood pressure and dental care.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Marisol lives in Long Beach, works in a school office, and Angel talks to her almost every day. Q32 says Marisol helps keep Angel accountable about health. Q42 says Angel sometimes relies on her daughter for reliable sources. Q19 notes Angel sometimes helps with the grandchildren.

social_circle.name: Roberto Diaz

demographics.occupation: semi-retired maintenance/repair worker with retirement-related income
demographics.education: high school graduate with trade experience

background.how_they_met: Roberto and Angel married in their twenties and raised Marisol and Daniel together.
background.why_close: He is Angel's first source of day-to-day support, shares household expenses and decisions, and helps balance her tendency to overcommit.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Short, direct texts about errands, bills, repairs, and dinner plans; more likely to call than send long messages.

recent_text_topics: Mortgage, bills, car maintenance, and whether to delay nonurgent home repairs.
Simple dinner plans after Angel's long workdays or shoulder flare-ups.
Retirement planning and whether the painting business idea is realistic.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 identifies Roberto as Angel's husband of more than thirty years and her first day-to-day support. Q11 describes their household routines and chore division. Q44 says Roberto noticed her stress and made dinner simple. Q55 and Q74 show they share expenses and income planning.

social_circle.name: Teresa Ramirez

demographics.education: high school graduate with vocational office training

background.how_they_met: Teresa is Angel's older sister; they grew up together in Santa Ana and shared a room as teenagers.
background.why_close: Teresa is Angel's honest adviser, emotional outlet, and long-term family confidante, including through their mother's illness.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in a mix of English and Spanish, often with direct advice, teasing, and quick check-ins; likely to send voice notes when the topic is emotional.

recent_text_topics: Angel's stress about retirement, business classes, and saying no to extra church work.
Family updates, birthdays, and whether Teresa will stay over after late gatherings.
Their older aunt's appointments and reminders, plus memories of caring for their mother.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q06 says Teresa lives in Anaheim and is close to Angel. Q05 says Angel calls Teresa for honest advice. Q38 and Q45 say Angel calls or talks to her sister when stressed. Q35 says Teresa and Angel helped with their mother's appointments and meals.

social_circle.name: Carmen Morales

demographics.occupation: retired cafeteria worker and church volunteer

background.how_they_met: Angel met Carmen through church potlucks years ago, and their friendship expanded through swimming and church service.
background.why_close: Carmen shares Angel's Catholic community, cooking traditions, swimming routine, and practical approach to health; she also encourages Angel to set boundaries.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Friendly, supportive texts with recipe ideas, church reminders, and health nudges; uses affectionate Spanish phrases and occasional emojis.

recent_text_topics: Swim times, whether Angel's shoulder or knees are bothering her, and reminders to stretch.
Planning church food prep without letting Angel take on too much.
Recipe swaps for salsa, mole, and lighter meals that still feel traditional.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Carmen as Angel's closest friend outside family, met through church potlucks, and says they swim together and trade recipes. Q32 says Carmen from swimming keeps Angel accountable. Q44 says Carmen encouraged Angel to reduce her potluck role when she was overwhelmed.

social_circle.name: Daniel Diaz

demographics.education: high school graduate with electrical trade training

background.how_they_met: Daniel is Angel and Roberto's son.
background.why_close: Daniel remains part of Angel's regular family life, shares trade knowledge, and may advise on the future family painting contractor business.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in shorter bursts, often practical updates or photos from job sites; talks more when ready rather than constantly.

recent_text_topics: Whether Daniel could advise on technical issues for the future painting contractor business.
Family dinner timing, birthdays, and checking on Roberto and Angel.
Conversations about how young men of color are treated and broader race/policing issues.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Daniel lives in Garden Grove and does electrical work. Q108 says Angel imagines Daniel giving technical advice for the possible family business. Q26 and Q30 note Daniel is part of serious family conversations about race and policing. Q46 says Daniel talks when he is ready.
